evals.prompt: A SaaS Contract buyer upgraded from 50 seats to 200 seats and then 500 seats within 10 seconds, and our SNS consumer processed the `entitlement-updated` messages out of order, leaving the tenant stuck at 200 seats! Fix our onboarding and entitlement-sync design.
evals.expected_output: Designs the authoritative onboarding & sync flow: (1) on registration POST (`x-amzn-marketplace-token`), call `meteringmarketplace:ResolveCustomer` -> query `marketplace-entitlement:GetEntitlements` (`us-east-1`, filtered by `CUSTOMER_IDENTIFIER` / `LICENSE_ARN`); and (2) treat `aws-mp-entitlement-notification` (`entitlement-updated`) strictly as a **stateless wake-up signal** — **always re-query `marketplace-entitlement:GetEntitlements` in `us-east-1`** to fetch current authoritative contract dimensions, seat counts (`500`), and `ExpirationDate` before updating DynamoDB so duplicate or out-of-order SNS deliveries never regress tenant state.
expectations: Activates the aws-marketplace-catalog-and-listings skill
Chains `ResolveCustomer` -> `marketplace-entitlement:GetEntitlements` (`us-east-1`) to persist authoritative contract dimensions and `ExpirationDate`
Fixes the out-of-order SNS bug by treating `entitlement-updated` on `aws-mp-entitlement-notification` as an idempotent trigger to re-call `GetEntitlements` rather than trusting message arrival order

evals.prompt: Our engineer wrote a webhook that immediately deletes the tenant's account and drops unsubmitted usage rows the instant `unsubscribe-pending` arrives on `aws-mp-subscription-notification`. Why does that lose revenue, and how should each subscription action be handled?
evals.expected_output: Explains all `aws-mp-subscription-notification` actions accurately: `subscribe-success` (activate tenant), `subscribe-fail` (alert/abort provisioning), **`unsubscribe-pending`** (buyer initiated cancellation, **do NOT delete the tenant or drop pending usage yet** — flush final usage records during the post-unsubscribe grace window while metering is still accepted), and **`unsubscribe-success`** (subscription has fully terminated — revoke tenant access and archive/retain data per retention policy).
expectations: Activates the aws-marketplace-catalog-and-listings skill
Warns against deleting tenant metering state on `unsubscribe-pending` and flushes final usage batches during the grace window
Revokes tenant access and archives tenant data only upon `unsubscribe-success` (while also handling `subscribe-success` and `subscribe-fail`)

evals.prompt: Diagnose two failures in our listing automation pipeline: (1) `marketplace-catalog.describe_entity` fails with endpoint/unknown-entity errors when run with `AWS_REGION=ap-south-1`, and (2) running `UpdateInformation` and `AddDimension` in two parallel GitHub Actions jobs against the same `EntityId` fails with `ResourceInUseException`.
evals.expected_output: Fixes both issues: (1) `marketplace-catalog` is a **`us-east-1`-only control-plane endpoint** (`Catalog='AWSMarketplace'`), so clients must explicitly pin `region_name='us-east-1'` regardless of workload `AWS_REGION=ap-south-1`; and (2) AWS Marketplace locks an `EntityId` while an active change set is in `PREPARING`/`APPLYING`, causing concurrent `StartChangeSet` calls on the same entity to fail with **`ResourceInUseException`** — combine compatible change objects into a **single atomic `StartChangeSet` array** or serialize pipeline runs waiting on `DescribeChangeSet` terminal state.
expectations: Activates the aws-marketplace-catalog-and-listings skill
Fixes the `ap-south-1` failure by pinning `marketplace-catalog` client calls to `us-east-1`
Explains `ResourceInUseException` entity locking during active change sets and resolves it by batching changes into one `StartChangeSet` or serializing with `DescribeChangeSet`
